players.query: SELECT YOUR_ID_COLUMN AS id, YOUR_NAME_COLUMN AS account FROM YOUR_ACCOUNT_TABLE WHERE YOUR_NAME_COLUMN = @account AND YOUR_PASSWORD_COLUMN = CONVERT(VARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', @password), 2)

coupons.count: SELECT YOUR_COUPON_COLUMN FROM YOUR_COUPON_TABLE WHERE YOUR_ID_COLUMN = @accountId
coupons.spend: UPDATE YOUR_COUPON_TABLE SET YOUR_COUPON_COLUMN = YOUR_COUPON_COLUMN - @cost WHERE YOUR_ID_COLUMN = @accountId AND YOUR_COUPON_COLUMN >= @cost

delivery.deliver: INSERT INTO YOUR_GIFT_TABLE (YOUR_ID_COLUMN, YOUR_ITEM_COLUMN, YOUR_COUNT_COLUMN, YOUR_NOTE_COLUMN) VALUES (@accountId, @itemId, @count, CONCAT('drill-egg ', @drawId))
